name: Flask CRUD Starter (strict)
description: Strict, editable Flask CRUD starter template with explicit structure, inputs, tests and constraints.

files.human_hint: Top-level application template. Use only variables listed in inputs.
Main index page UI template with item listing and navigation.
Installation and customization steps. Must include 'How to edit' section.

validation.error_message: Project name must be 3-64 characters and may contain letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores.

ui.label: Project name
ui.help: Used for package and directory names; will be slugified as necessary.

validation.error_message: Database URL must be sqlite:///..., postgresql://... or mysql://...

ui.label: Include auth scaffolding
ui.help: If true, templates will include basic auth routes and models.

invariants.description: Template generation must not perform outbound network calls during generation phase.
Templates may only read variables declared in inputs or manifest metadata.
Templates must not embed secrets in plain text; tests should detect secrets.

instructions: Only generate files declared in 'files' and produce only variables listed in 'inputs'.
Respect 'structure' node roles and do not create deeper nesting than 'maxDepth'.
When adding code, include clear inline comments and a 'HOW TO EDIT' section in README.md explaining which lines a human is expected to edit.
Provide a mapping table at top of README.md: generated file -> purpose -> editable sections (line ranges or markers).
For toggled features (e.g., use_auth), create clear feature guards and document where to remove/extend them.

prompt_template_for_ai: Given the manifest JSON (provided separately) and user inputs, generate the required Jinja template files. Output only the packaged files in the exact paths declared. Ensure tests in 'tests' pass.

tests.name: Generate basic structure
tests.description: Run template generation with example inputs and assert expected files exist and contain required markers.

recommended_editing_workflow: 1) Use cheetah-cli validate to confirm manifest correctness.
2) Generate with cheetah-cli generate to get baseline.
3) Edit only within HUMAN-EDIT markers in generated files.
4) Re-run tests and commit edits with version bump.
